question: HJKN is related to EGHK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, QSTW is related to NPQT. To which of the following is IKLO related, following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] The logic followed here is: (3) is subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series. So, HJKN is related to EGHK
